notes: Small LCD supplies complete labels when enlarged display clips them. Spaces describe label separation, not pixel spacing; menu selector dot omitted.
Steps 81-84 exploratory nCr input corrected before CNST; Error 2 is not an application defect.
MEM and RESET prompts cancelled with ON/C; no deletion confirmed.
Final HOME leaves FIX active. Stores not read back; empty observations means unmeasured.
Exposure inventory only; precision, cursor, all-mode compatibility and application parity remain pending.

Steps 116-119: second-function up and ALPHA up on an empty formula memory both cleared the modifier without visible output. Recall semantics remain unresolved; labels alone do not prove modifier dispatch.
